notes: PA14 has a native Type I-F CRISPR-Cas system with two CRISPR loci and experimentally studied phage targeting.
E. coli K-12 is a model Type I-E CRISPR-Cas system; included as a curated type/subtype seed, not as a phage-resistance label.
SF370 contains the native SpyCas9 Type II-A CRISPR-Cas system with six spacers; array-coordinate scope avoids labeling unrelated repeat structures.
U112 contains the native Cpf1/Cas12a Type V-A CRISPR-Cas system; included as a curated type/subtype seed.
RP62A harbors a model Type III-A CRISPR-Cas system with antiplasmid immunity; included as a curated type/subtype seed.
